rationale:
SHORT ROUND, at the owner's direction, to close a trail that has stood at REVISE x4 since 2026-08-15 while the two questions it deadlocked on were taken to the owner and RULED.

THIS ROUND CONTAINS EXACTLY ONE EDIT, AND IT IS NOT A RESTATEMENT. Round 4 was gated by editquality at HIGH on 'a no-op dressed as an edit' — four of its edits were already-committed work re-listed as pending. That objection was correct and is not repeated: the single edit below is a code change that landed at 2026-08-15 18:16Z, THREE HOURS AND THIRTY-FIVE MINUTES AFTER round 4's verdict was written at 14:41Z, so no round of this trail has ever seen it. It is the literal reversal of the change two seats objected to at HIGH and MEDIUM severity.

WHAT THE OWNER RULED, AND WHAT SHIPPED AS A RESULT.
(1) improvement_guardian objected at HIGH (rounds 3 AND 4) that filing this item_type born 'triaged' removes the observe-only stage the loop depends on. The seat was right, and the honest answer was not available to the author: the detected->triaged promoter had been dead since 2026-05-02, so born-'detected' meant born-STRANDED. The owner ruled on 2026-08-15 to fix the cause rather than accept the workaround — bugs_open/083 candidate 2, 'give triage its own scheduled task, decoupled from the fix loop'. That promoter was built the same day (seed 430, register SCH-026), hardened by migration 444, and was APPROVED BY THIS COUNCIL on 2026-08-17 at corr 05a3d1c8 with 12 seats in favour. With the stage restored, the producer went back to born-'detected' — the edit below. improvement_guardian's objection is answered by the code now in production, not by an argument.
(2) reuse_agent, guardian and architecture all objected that this is the third single-type classify+route SQL router and that the consolidation engine keeps being deferred. The owner ruled RFC_030 and SCHEDULED it as its own lane (docs024_key_docs_latest/router_engine/, created with PLAN/HANDOFF/NOTES/RUNBOOK/README). The seats' specific ask was sharper than that, and this round does NOT claim it is met — see risk 1.

prior_art_librarian's HIGH on the 'sole live carrier' premise is also settled, and by that seat's own hand: it re-examined the identical premise on corr 05a3d1c8 on 2026-08-17 and APPROVED. The landmine it cited ('two other agents run the same step') predates migration 286, which removed the other two carriers.

WHAT THIS ROUND DOES NOT CLOSE, STATED UP FRONT SO NO SEAT HAS TO FIND IT. bug_historian's HIGH objection to the convert arms is neither resolved nor refuted — it is UNEXERCISED, which nobody had measured until today, and the measurement is in grounded_in [6]. The owner has that decision in front of them now. This round asks for a verdict on a trail whose original subject is live, drained and independently corroborated; it does not ask the council to bless the convert arms.

grounded_in: [1] TIMING, which is what makes this edit reviewable rather than a restatement. Round 4's verdict: diagnosis_artifacts kind='council_report', correlation 7b0e2833-715f-4a9a-897b-efd913073582, created_at 2026-08-15 14:41:16Z (the fourth and latest of four 'revise' rows). The edit's commit: git log -1 --date=iso 3c6354059 -> 2026-08-15 19:16:07 +0100 = 18:16:07Z. Delta 3h35m. No round of this trail has judged the current state of this file.

[2] THE MECHANISM improvement_guardian's OBJECTION REQUIRED NOW EXISTS AND IS COUNCIL-APPROVED. detected-item-promoter, seed 430 + migration 444, register SCH-026, live on a 900s cadence. Council corr 05a3d1c8: round 1 REVISE 2026-08-15, round 2 APPROVED 2026-08-17 11:27Z — 12 seats approving, 3 abstained, gated_by_truncation=false, 2 advisory objections neither of them high. So the observe-only stage this producer now files into is not asserted to exist; it has been separately reviewed and approved by this council.

[3] prior_art_librarian's OWN HIGH OBJECTION, SETTLED BY prior_art_librarian. Round 4 (edit 3, HIGH): the 'sole live carrier' premise is 'unverified' and contradicted by a landmine saying 'two other agents run the same step'. Re-measured live a third time 2026-08-17: SELECT type FROM agent_definitions WHERE is_active AND COALESCE(is_snapshot,false)=false AND deleted_at IS NULL AND default_config::text LIKE '%triage_detected_items%' -> exactly ONE row, improvement-loop; improvement-sweep enabled=FALSE, last fired 2026-08-14. The cited landmine predates migration 286, which removed the other two carriers — it is a dated snapshot, not a live count. This seat reviewed the identical premise on corr 05a3d1c8 and APPROVED on 2026-08-17.

[4] OWNER RULING 1 (2026-08-15), recorded in bugs_open/083 under 'OWNER RULING 2026-08-15 — candidate 2 chosen and BUILT': 'do 083, as candidate 2 — give triage its own scheduled task, decoupled from the fix loop: promote detected -> triaged on a slow cadence for item types whose handlers are known-good, leaving discovery itself manual.' Candidate 1 (re-enable improvement-sweep wholesale) was explicitly not chosen.

[5] OWNER RULING 2 (2026-08-15): RFC_030 RULED and SCHEDULED as its own lane — docs024_key_docs_latest/router_engine/ created with PLAN, HANDOFF, NOTES, RUNBOOK and README; nothing built, deliberately; first job is an A-vs-B design round with this council on the engine's shape. Commit a75a33760.

[6] bug_historian's HIGH (round 4, edit 1) IS UNEXERCISED, NOT RESOLVED — measured 2026-08-17, and nobody had measured it before. Every route this router has ever taken, all history: no_content_data 35, asset_sourced 1, no_plan_owned 1. file_rewrite 0, file_recreate 0. And SELECT count(*) FROM site_work_items WHERE parent_item_id IN (SELECT id FROM site_work_items WHERE item_type='required_fields_missing') -> 0, so the router has produced ZERO child work items in its lifetime. The two conversions attempted during the fleet assignment were cancelled. The regeneration risk the seat named (closed case 056; missingkey=zero renders a missing required field as empty with no error) is therefore entirely theoretical so far — and the first run of those arms will be in production, unrehearsed. See risk 2.

[7] THE ROUTER'S CENTRAL CLASSIFICATION JUDGEMENT, INDEPENDENTLY CORROBORATED — the strongest evidence this trail has and it did not exist at round 4. bugs_open/033's auto-drain (revalidate_review_queue_action.go) acquired a revalidator for required_fields_missing and swept the parked pile at 2026-08-17 08:45Z. It knows nothing about this router and re-evaluates each finding against deployed state from its own premises. Row-for-row agreement: router 'no_content_data' -> revalidator 'unknown: component carries no content_data; it renders from another source' (29 rows); router 'no_plan_owned' -> 'unknown' (1); router 'asset_sourced' -> 'still_holds: at least one reported-missing field is still empty on the deployed component' (1). It did not have to agree — a revalidator that disagreed would have returned 'resolved' and auto-closed the lot. This is exactly the claim a reviewer should most doubt (that 35 of 44 findings were blob-served pages an automatic repair would have destroyed), confirmed from outside.

[8] THE ORIGINAL SUBJECT IS LIVE AND DRAINED. required_fields_missing all-time partition 2026-08-17: complete 64, needs_human_review 31, nothing else — zero triaged, zero blocked, zero unresolved, zero unrouted. Churn guard at day 2 of 7: exactly ONE row created since the 2026-08-15 14:50Z fleet assignment, which traversed the whole chain as designed (born detected -> promoted by SCH-026 -> routed by CQ-023 -> parked carrying its classification). Of the 31 parked rows exactly one is a live actionable finding; before this work all 44 were indistinguishable.

[9] LIVENESS VERIFIED AT THE ARTEFACT, answering prior_art_librarian's round-4 MEDIUM that deployed-binary claims are 'exactly the class of claim the landmines warn is routinely wrong'. Not a pod-grep for a marker: chassis v1.0.1305, OCI label org.opencontainers.image.revision = 6a782274b read from the image, then confirmed in the running binary with BOTH controls in one exec — the label sha PRESENT in /proc/1/exe, and live HEAD 896c5aeeb (a real but different commit) ABSENT. git merge-base --is-ancestor 3c6354059 6a782274b exits 0. The 'build provenance' startup log line had already scrolled past --tail=100000 on both pods, which is why the label+binary route was used.

[10] editquality's ROUND-4 GATING OBJECTION, ACKNOWLEDGED AND NOT REPEATED. It found four edits that were already-committed work re-listed as pending ('a no-op dressed as an edit', HIGH). This plan lists ONE edit, whose commit post-dates that verdict by 3h35m [1]. Everything else that has shipped since — seed 430, migration 444, the register entries, the bug-file records — is cited here as evidence, deliberately NOT listed as a plan edit, and 430+444 were reviewed on their own correlation [2] rather than twice.
plan.risks:
1) THE RFC_030 SEATS' ASK IS NOT MET, AND THIS ROUND DOES NOT CLAIM IT IS. reuse_agent, guardian and architecture did not merely ask that consolidation be tracked; they asked that it be a real gate — 'acceptable only if RFC_030 is genuinely a hard gate on a 4th router, not aspirational', and 'the deferral risks becoming permanent as each new type finds it cheaper to add a fourth router than to build the shared one'. What exists is an owner ruling and a lane with a plan and no code. That is more than tracking and less than a gate. If a seat wants to object again on this ground it would be right to, and the honest place for it is the router_engine lane's own design round, not a fifth round here.

2) THE CONVERT ARMS ARE UNTESTED AND AN OWNER DECISION IS PENDING ON THEM. bug_historian's HIGH stands as a live question: file_rewrite and file_recreate have never run [6], and the first time they do it will be on a customer page. The estate's own remedy is the owner ruling of 2026-08-02 §2 (new authority on a shared seam ships as an opt-in field with the unsafe default OFF; RFC_022 then confirms that shape is not architecture-scope). It was deliberately NOT applied unilaterally: it changes the safety posture of an owner-blessed mechanism, and the arms are conditional_branch steps whose then_step is data, so 'opt-in' means either a new expression form or redirecting to a park step — a design call, now with the owner. A seat that wants those arms gated before this trail closes should say so plainly and it will carry weight with that decision.

3) THE PARKED ROWS NOW HAVE A SECOND WRITER, WHICH NOBODY DESIGNED. 033's revalidator writes result.revalidation onto rows this router parked with result.route, and the dispatch loop's mark_complete REPLACES result on completed rows. Today they compose correctly — both keys sit side by side in the same object — but nothing guarantees it, and a future writer of either mechanism could clobber the other's evidence. Named as a known seam.

4) THE BACKLOG DROP IS MOSTLY NOT THIS ROUTER'S WORK. 56 rows of the type were auto-closed 'resolved' by 033's revalidator. Recorded so the counts do not flatter this change: this router's contribution is that the survivors carry a classification, not that the queue got smaller.
